name: Dwarven Tinder
summary: In the Wetlands, Dwarven Tinder gives Alliance saboteurs a way to burn Dragonmaw siege engines before they reach Menethil Harbor.

sections.title: Sabotaging the Dragonmaw
sections.body: When Alliance scouts found Chieftain Nek'rosh's heavy catapults inside the Dragonmaw encampment, Menethil Harbor faced a crisis. Fighting in Dun Algaz had cut off the harbor from southern reinforcements, and its defenders could not withstand a long siege. They chose to sabotage the catapults before they could be used. Volunteers carrying Dwarven Tinder into orcish territory could light it with a struck spark. Its flames burned through the reinforced wooden engines in minutes.

faq.q: What is Dwarven Tinder used for?
faq.answer: Alliance saboteurs use Dwarven Tinder to burn the Dragonmaw catapults in the Wetlands before they can attack Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why burn the catapults instead of capturing them?
aliases: why not take the siege engines
faq.answer: The defenders cannot capture heavy siege engines deep in Dragonmaw territory. With the garrison outnumbered and cut off from Ironforge reinforcements by the blockade at Dun Algaz, destroying the catapults is their only viable defense.

aliases: where does dwarven tinder come from
faq.answer: The dwarven garrison at Menethil Harbor supplies the tinder, prepared to catch fire quickly and reliably during sabotage runs.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know dependable firestarters matter in the Wetlands, where rain and bogs keep the land perpetually soggy.
As an Alliance member, you know burning enemy war engines before they reach Menethil Harbor helps keep your primary marsh port standing while the Dun Algaz passes are contested.
